name: Can I install a new stone countertop on my existing vanity cabinet?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a new stone countertop on my existing vanity cabinet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can keep your existing vanity base, provided the cabinet framework is structurally sound and level. Heavy natural stone slabs like granite and marble require solid cabinet support along the perimeter and central dividers. Before placing a new slab, installers check for water damage, warped face frames, and soft wood around the floor base. If the vanity leans or flexes, it must be shimmed and anchored securely to the wall studs to prevent the stone from cracking under its own weight.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, as long as the cabinet is structurally sound, level, and free of moisture damage. Installers must confirm it can support the weight of heavy stone slabs.
